streetAddress: 1-11 Goldsworthy's Road, Pouch Cove, NL A0A3L0
description: Where the rugged cliffs of the shoreline meet the majestic Atlantic Ocean. Where the golden rays of sun beam through the Evergreens & dance along the misted tips of grass glistening from the morning dew. From sunrise to sunset, everything you see is picturesque. Hear the waves crash along the coastline while the sea birds fly overhead; sip your favorite beverage & breathe in the fresh salty air. From these 7 acres of land, this is your scenery; this is your serenity, every day. Located in the scenic & quaint town of Pouch Cove, dating back to 1611, it is well known for its exceptional beauty & rustic charm, its impressive hiking trails & coveted berry-picking grounds, its renowned artist residency & rural setting. This captivating community is home to just over 2000 people & only 27 kilometers North of St. John’s. The Town's motto is "First To See The Sun" & it does not disappoint! Here you will find this rare opportunity to build your home, or possibly a development of your preference as the possibilities are only limited by one’s imagination. And to imagine… awakening to the warm touch of the sun as it rises above the vast expanse of the ocean, painting both the sky & water a brilliant hue. The day greets you, & you, it. Outside, your 7 acres of land - stretching 600 feet along the stunning shoreline of the Atlantic ocean - your backyard, a place to explore, a place of beauty & of peace. Your lungs fill with the cool, salty breeze as you pick the sun-sweetened berries on your property & gaze out over the sea & surrounding landscape, listening to the birds sing & whales spray. From your doorstep you walk along the East Coast trail then retire home, for some rest & watch the sun set over the hillside, & as the moon rises, you watch & listen until you drift off to sleep to the lull the waves against the moonlit coastline, eager for another day. Just 25 minutes from St. John's, standing upon this vacant land, you realize this is where your imagination comes to life. (id:38686)
